name: Ningbo TIP Rubber Technology Co.,Ltd
summary: Ningbo TIP Rubber Technology Co.,Ltd researches, develops, manufactures, and sells polymer material fluid piping systems, and sealing system parts and assemblies for automobiles in China and internationally. It offers engine accessory system hoses and assemblies; automobile air conditioning systems; power steering systems; body accessory system hoses and assemblies; fuel system hoses and assemblies; and molded related products. The company was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Ningbo, China. Ningbo TIP Rubber Technology Co.,Ltd operates as a subsidiary of Zhejiang Tianpu Holdings Co., Ltd.
